Title: Lead Analyst (Hybrid/Toronto Based)
Description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Supply Analytics team delivers data-driven insights and decision support to optimize Agoda’s supply ecosystem. We analyze partner and marketplace dynamics, build forecasts and models, run experiments, and create scalable dashboards and data products that power strategic direction and operational execution. We bring value through rigorous analyses and pragmatic, measurable recommendations that help Supply, Product and other teams prioritize work and drive impact. Our work improves inventory quality, partner economics, and the long-term health and growth of Agoda.

The Opportunity:

As a Lead Analyst/Senior Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.

In this Role, you’ll get to:


Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)
Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.
Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.
Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.
Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.
Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations


What you’ll Need to Succeed:


At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BI
Advanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQL
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably)
Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)
Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)
Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentation
Strong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the business
A hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.
Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.
Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.
Willingness and able to work 2-3 evenings per week to meet with the Bangkok office and regional partners.


It’s Great if you Have:


MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.
Asian market experience.
Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.


There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

The range for Ontario area is $80,000-120,000 CAD.

Title: BI Engineer
Description:
Who We Are

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.

We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.

And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values

Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.

Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.

Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.

Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer who is solutions-oriented, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity. This individual will not simply respond to requests but will lead initiatives, identify opportunities, and use data to unlock business growth. You will play a key role in maintaining data flow across systems, building scalable data models, and partnering across teams to inform decision-making. The ideal candidate will have 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing, with deep expertise in SQL, data pipelines, visualization tools, and cloud-based data architecture.

You Are


Proactive. You take full ownership of your domain and drive action independently.
Insightful. You generate meaningful, data-driven insights that fuel decision-making.
Collaborative. You work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve processes.
Technical. You have a strong command of data engineering, visualization, and analytical tools.


You Will


Take ownership of the Business Intelligence domain, surfacing insights, solving problems, and driving data-driven decisions
Partner with stakeholders in product, sales, and operations to ensure data quality, availability, and effective usage
Manipulate and transform large datasets using SQL and scripting languages to generate impactful business insights
Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to optimize strategies
Apply data science fundamentals to build predictive models and trend analyses
Develop scalable data models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Domo
Continuously improve data pipelines, infrastructure, and analytical capabilities
Mentor colleagues to enhance analytics capabilities and foster a data-driven culture


Who You Will Work With

This role reports into the BI Manager and collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, and Data Engineering teams. You will also work closely with senior leadership to support key strategic initiatives.

Must Have’s


2+ years of experience in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence
Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
Strong experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline management
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, Scala)
Strong foundation in data modeling, governance, and structuring datasets for long-term use
Expertise in data visualization and dashboarding (Domo preferred)
Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel, Google Sheets)
Self-starter with strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities


Nice To Have’s


Experience working with DOMO specifically
Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and security best practices
Experience creating and implementing data governance strategies
Background in data science or machine learning application
Familiarity with API integrations and automation techniques


What We Offer


Competitive pay
Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)
Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match
Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time
Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)
Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)
Robust Employee Assistance Program
Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer
Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs
Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization
Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement


Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Compensation Range Of

Annual Salary: $110,000.00 - $120,000.00 CAD

(Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

Title: Operations Analyst
Description:
Charger logistics Inc. is a world- class asset-based carrier with locations across North America. With over 20 years of experience providing the best logistics solutions, Charger logistics has transformed into a world-class transport provider and continue to grow.

We are seeking an individual with excellent communication and leadership skills to join the company. Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies.

We are looking for a data-driven Operations Analyst to join our team. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical skills with industry knowledge to drive continuous improvement in our damage mitigation programs.

Responsibilities:

Support Sales, Operations, and Customer Service teams with competitive pricing, in-depth performance analysis, and data-driven insights
Perform costing analysis and develop multi-scenario pricing options to support customer negotiations
Assist in building and evaluating pricing strategies; analyze volume, profit potential, and market trends
Monitor customer performance across volume, revenue, and margin; identify gaps and inconsistencies
Respond to pricing inquiries and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner
Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from internal operational databases
Build custom reports and analytics dashboards using Tableau and other BI tools; present findings to leadership
Ensure accurate, clean reporting flows directly to leadership and upper management

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$147,900 - CA$221,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Location: Toronto, 100% on site required

Bonus: Maximum 50% per annum

Company:

Join our creative and innovative team as we connect and entertain players all around the world, creating exciting experiences and lasting connections, on the world’s largest online poker network and biggest poker events!




Home of World Champion Daniel Negreanu, Winner of the Best Poker Software, and Guinness World Records holder of the largest ever online poker prize pool, GGPoker has taken the poker world by storm.




Headquartered in Toronto with offices in 9 major cities and 700 top international talents, NSUS is an industry-leading global company dedicated to shaping the future of gaming. GGPoker holds the largest online poker market share globally, and we are looking for dynamic, innovative, and passionate team members to be part of the World’s #1.




Join us and be part of the very best in the iGaming space!




Position:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our lean, fast-moving Business Intelligence team at GGPoker, the leading online poker platform in the world. You’ll work in a high-impact environment where data drives every decision.




This role is ideal for someone who is naturally curious, moves fast, and thrives at uncovering the story behind the numbers. You won't just build reports, you'll own them, evolve them, and proactively bring insights to the table before anyone has to ask. If you're the type of person who spots something off in a dataset and can't let it go until you understand why, we want to hear from you.




You will report directly to the Head of Business Intelligence.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Proactive Monitoring & Issue Detection: Stay ahead of the numbers. Identify trends, anomalies, and performance shifts before they become problems and bring clear, actionable findings to stakeholders
Data Visualization & Reporting: Build, own and maintain dynamic Tableau dashboards that non-technical stakeholders can understand instantly.
Player & Business Analysis: Analyze large, complex datasets to understand player behavior, product performance, and business trends, connecting quantitative patterns to real business impact
Data Design: Write and optimize SQL queries against our Snowflake data warehouse to extract critical information that meets evolving stakeholder needs
KPI Development: Lead and support the development and improvement of core business metrics including LTV, Churn, CAC, and regional performance indicators
Forecasting & Budgeting: Monitor and track performance against forecasting models, flagging deviations and contributing to planning cycles
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear, concise executive summaries that drive decisions, not just inform them
A/B Testing & Experimentation: Support the design and evaluation of experiments on product and promotional changes




Requirements - Soft Skills:




Fast learner who thrives under pressure. You pick things up quickly, adapt on the fly, and don't need a lot of hand-holding to get up to speed
Resourceful and self-directed. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it. You figure things out independently before escalating
Genuinely curious. You ask why, not just what. You dig into the data because you actually want to understand it, not just because someone asked you to
Strong ownership mentality. You treat your work like it's yours and don't wait to be told something needs fixing
Business and finance intuition. You understand what the numbers mean for the business, not just what they say on the surface
Clear, confident communicator. You can explain a complex finding to a non-technical executive in two sentences
Organized and detail-oriented. You QA your own work, catch your own errors, and don't ship something you're not confident in




Requirements - Technical Skills:




Strong SQL skills (required). You're comfortable writing complex queries against large datasets independently
Experience with Tableau or other BI visualization tools (required)
Experience with Snowflake or equivalent cloud-based data warehouses (required)




Definitely Apply if You Have:




Experience in iGaming, fintech, or high-volume data environments (strong asset)
Experience in a startup or high-growth environment (asset)
Passion for poker, strategy games, or competitive gaming (asset)
Familiarity with KPI frameworks in a gaming or subscription or retention business
Experience supporting forecasting or budgeting cycles
Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks




Total Rewards:




Annual salary and level review
Max 50% bonus per annum
Paid vacation and sick time off
Flexible and comprehensive benefits
Commute coverage
Birthday Gift
GGPoker Swag
Preferred Gym rate
Endless snacks and beverages

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Metergy Solutions Inc. (“Metergy”)
Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

Our Mission
Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

Title: Data Scientist, Analytics (Remote, Canada)
Description:
Data Scientist, Analytics

(Remote, Canada)

Events in recent years have made us all too familiar with the havoc that natural disasters can wreak, and the increasing frequency and intensity with which they are occurring. Despite record levels of losses, conventional methods of risk modeling continue to paint at best an incomplete picture of these threats.

ZestyAI uses novel data gathering and data science methods to produce higher quality information about the risks to property from catastrophes like storms and wildfires. While AI alone may not be able to thwart these disasters, it can help us become more prepared for them, and ultimately that will lead to better outcomes.

As a Data Scientist, Analytics, you will work closely with product, engineering, and machine learning teams to apply data science to complex product and business problems.You will use diverse data sources to evaluate product performance, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making across ZestyAI's products.You will also help establish the analytical processes, monitoring frameworks, and best practices needed to maintain product quality and scale the organization. You thrive in a collaborative, creative environment that moves fast and are comfortable implementing structures and processes to help the company scale.

The Opportunity:


Translate product management, engineering, and business questions into structured analytical approaches, applying appropriate statistical, experimental, and data science methods to measure product performance and guide decision-making
Own data quality of ZestyAI data products
Spearhead product monitoring and quality assurance by designing and owning dashboards and KPIs
Develop automated ETL and data workflows
Iterate rapidly on everything; all of the above happens in a fast-paced business-driven environment that you must be comfortable with


What You Bring to the ZestyAI Team:


BA / BS degree in Math, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Economics
MS or Ph.D. is certainly a bonus
2–3 years of experience in analytics, data science, or related roles, including experience building data workflows, defining metrics, and developing dashboards or monitoring tools
Strong organizational and management skills with past experiences implementing best practices and processes
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous, cross-functional questions
Proficient in SQL
Proficient in programming language (Python or R)
Experience working with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, etc)
Must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Nice to Have:


1 - 2 years of experience working with imagery and/or geospatial data
Working knowledge of modeling framework and performance metrics
Familiarity with, or an interest in, experimental design, causal inference, and applied statistical methods
DBT Experience
Prefect (or another workflow tool like Airflow) Experience
Data Visualization Experience


Why ZestyAI:


Be part of a well-funded growth-stage company
Market competitive comp and equity incentives to give you a stake in our future
Comprehensive health care plan
Flexible Time Off
An upbeat and collaborative work culture
Company-sponsored outings and offsites

Description:
Enercare Inc. is one of Canada’s largest home and commercial services companies servicing over one million customers across Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Alberta, British Columbia, Quebec and New Brunswick. Enercare is the Experts at Home, operating under several brands including Enercare, HydroSolution, and Pioneer Plumbing & Heating.

Role: Workforce Analyst

Status: Full-Time

Location: Markham

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618

Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

Summary

The Workforce Analyst – Capacity Planning is a pivotal role at Enercare HVAC Services, leveraging advanced analytics to ensure optimal workforce capacity and exceptional customer outcomes. This position is responsible for real-time monitoring of service queues, and workforce utilization, while driving predictive planning and weather-driven demand forecasting.

This role is central to balancing real-time operational demands with long-term workforce strategy. Effective monitoring, forecasting, and analytics directly influence technician efficiency, customer satisfaction, and Enercare’s ability to consistently deliver same-day, high-quality HVAC service. The Real-Time Capacity & Workforce Analyst is instrumental in maintaining operational excellence and driving proactive improvements across the organization.

Responsibilities


Monitor service queues continuously, ensuring optimal call and task routing to dispatch teams.
Identify and escalate risks of SLA breaches and service delays on all service dispatch related queues.
Track technician idle time, utilization, and route efficiency to maximize productivity.
Provide live operational recommendations to management for stabilizing service delivery.
Ensure appropriate staffing levels are in place based on forecast analysis and real time insights into service queue volumes.
Develop and maintain capacity forecasting models across intraday, short‑term, medium‑term, and long‑term horizons.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and executive-level reports for operational visibility.
Generate and analyze reports from IFS systems and other operational datasets.
Conduct KPI trend analysis across productivity, service levels, and technician performance.
Perform predictive modelling to anticipate workload surges, staffing gaps, and potential service risks.
Translate complex data into actionable insights for operational leadership and decision-making.
Provide insights and recommendations on balancing technician supply vs demand by hour, skill, and geography.
Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess operational risk.
Build demand forecasting models utilizing historical data, seasonality, and weather patterns.
Support seasonal hiring and workforce ramp-up/ramp-down strategies to align with anticipated demand
Coordinate with marketing teams on maintenance campaigns and proactive service initiatives.
Collaborate with HR, operations, and vendor management teams to ensure staffing matches projected demand across all teams within end to end service lifecycle.


Qualifications


Preferred diploma or degree in business management, analytics, data science or a related area of study
3+ years of capacity, workforce or related analytics experience
1-2 years of business process experience with a proven ability to clearly communicate and articulate business requirements and use cases
Ability to create and deliver presentations to senior leadership
Strong collaboration skills
Strong change management skills
Analytical – ability to pull multiple data sets and present areas of opportunity
Knowledge of HVAC industry an asset

The Compliance Analyst supports the Compliance team by analyzing purchasing and operational data to identify compliance gaps and business opportunities. The role provides data-driven insights, supports compliance initiatives, and assists with coordinating follow-up actions across stakeholders. It requires strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and clear communication of findings. A practical understanding of food products and foodservice operations is important to ensure recommendations are relevant and actionable.

Now, If You Were To Come On Board As One Of Our Compliance Analysts, We’d Ask You To Do The Following For Us


Analyze purchasing and operational data to identify trends, compliance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Conduct recurring and ad hoc analyses to support compliance initiatives and business needs.
Quantify financial and operational impacts of identified opportunities and provide supporting analysis.
Prepare summaries, reports, and presentations for internal reviews and stakeholder discussions.
Support coordination of follow-up actions by communicating with internal teams and external partners as required, including scheduling meetings and tracking outcomes.
Assist in facilitating discussions by organizing information, preparing materials, and documenting decisions and action items.
Maintain and update dashboards, trackers, and supporting data tools to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Support operational processes related to product and item changes to ensure alignment with business requirements.
Provide analytical support for special projects and other departmental priorities as needed.


Role

Think you have what it takes to be our Compliance Analyst? We’re committed to hiring the best talent for the role. Here’s how we’ll know you’ll be successful in the role:


Post-secondary degree or diploma in Business, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Finance, Food Service, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Five (5) years of experience in Supply Chain Management, Food Service, and/or Data Analytics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to interpret data and generate practical recommendations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI or similar tools is an asset.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to structure information clearly in emails, reports, and presentations.
Comfortable coordinating meetings and following up with multiple stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsible for maintenance and quality of existing product information to ensure complete and accurate information in the Product Information Management (PIM) System. To support business initiative related to changing product information while maintaining the data integrity and hierarchy structure.

You Will


Execute analysis and track progress of initiatives for global and Acklands-Grainger supplier and purchasing functions

You Have


Systems Proficiency - Teradata, Snowflake, Excel, Word and Access
Analytical Skill -- Proven experience in managing and analysis of product information data. Highly skilled at analyzing large sets of data and sorting relevant information. Proficiency in use of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook, Visio, Access).
Customer Knowledge – Keen awareness of increasing customer expectations around Product Information. Experience with MRO product information preferred. Understands Product Information strategies.
Relationship Building - Build and maintain relationships in a matrixed corporate environment as well as Grainger suppliers. Good interpersonal skills, including the ability to deal and build relationships with various levels of the organization and Grainger Suppliers. Ability to work independently and in a team environment
Communication - Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Proven ability to communicate messages within the organization and Grainger Suppliers. Able to work well with others within team and across the organization.
Time Management – Proven ability to demonstrate flexibility and time management skills to accomplish multiple priorities and initiatives. Models customer focus in terms of response time, commitment, and resourcefulness
Technical Knowledge – Able to understand technical information, concepts, and decisions. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply proprietary analytical tools. Demonstrated ability to use technical support or technical data. Ability to quickly learn, become competent in, and effectively apply new technologies or processes.
Attention to Detail - Excellent attention to detail specific to relevant, accurate, and complete product information

Change Management – foster collaboration cross-functionally; identify and manage impacts to key stakeholders; influence without authority; create alignment to achieve objectives
Bilingual (English/French) is an asset but not required

Description:
Pay Range: $95,000 - $125,000

At The Home Depot Canada, we want you to feel valued and supported. The pay range you see represents base salary only. In addition, your total rewards may include: semi-annual bonuses tied to business performance; Deferred Profit-Sharing Program to assist with retirement savings; comprehensive paid benefits; a 15% discount on Home Depot stock purchases; and merit-based salary increases. We are committed to recognizing your efforts and supporting your growth with us.

Are you someone who thrives on helping others succeed, enjoys making an impact, and takes pride in guiding customers to the right solutions for their projects? If you’re also naturally curious and eager to keep learning, consider starting or growing your career with us at The Home Depot.

Web Analytics Lead will play a key role within the Web Data Enablement and Analytics Reporting Team, providing leadership to drive data informed decision-making for our website and mobile app. Leveraging deep expertise in Adobe Analytics, this role will manage platform configurations, ensure data accuracy, and develop robust web analytics strategies. The Lead will mentor junior analysts and act as a key liaison across Product, Marketing, UX, and IT teams, translating business requirements into actionable web data solutions that enhance user experience and drive online business growth. This role also involves conducting in-depth clickstream data analysis and collaborating with data engineering and other analytics teams to deliver enterprise-level dashboards and reports using tools like Tableau.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and execute web analytics strategy aligned with business goals, leading initiatives to enhance Adobe Analytics capabilities.
Serve as a subject matter expert in Adobe Analytics, advising stakeholders on best practices and guiding them in creating self-serve reporting solutions.
Collaborate with E-Commerce, Marketing, and IT teams to collect and translate business requirements into web data enablement in Adobe and actionable reporting solutions.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards integrating Adobe Analytics and other data sources to deliver actionable insights on website performance and user behavior.
Evaluate the impact of website user experience updates and marketing campaigns on KPIs such as TOF/BOF metrics, conversion rates, and user engagement, offering optimization recommendations.
Define, monitor, and report on e-commerce KPIs (e.g., funnel performance) to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Ensure data accuracy and platform performance by maintaining Adobe Analytics configurations and aligning data tracking with business needs and reporting requirements.
Conduct in-depth clickstream data analysis, curate raw data for reporting, and collaborate with Data Engineering for seamless warehouse integrations.

University Degree in analytics, BI, computer science, business, engineering or a related field
3+ years of progressive experience in digital analytics & reporting, with strong expertise in Adobe Analytics.
Proficiency in digital analytics implementation, data analysis, and optimization to optimize user experience and conversion rates.
Familiarity with SQL, GCP, and visualization tools such as Tableau or Looker is a plus.
Strong analytical skills to assess sales impact, correlate data with customer touchpoints, and propose actionable improvements.

Title: Data Scientist / Senior Analyst (Hybrid/Toronto Based)
Description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Supply Analytics team delivers data-driven insights and decision support to optimize Agoda’s supply ecosystem. We analyze partner and marketplace dynamics, build forecasts and models, run experiments, and create scalable dashboards and data products that power strategic direction and operational execution. We bring value through rigorous analyses and pragmatic, measurable recommendations that help Supply, Product and other teams prioritize work and drive impact. Our work improves inventory quality, partner economics, and the long-term health and growth of Agoda.

The Opportunity:

As a Data Scientist/Senior Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.

In this Role, you’ll get to:


Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)
Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.
Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.
Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.
Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.
Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations


What you’ll Need to Succeed:


At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BI
Advanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQL
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably)
Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)
Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)
Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentation
Strong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the business
A hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.
Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.
Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.
Willingness and able to work 2-3 evenings per week to meet with the Bangkok office and regional partners.


It’s Great if you Have:


MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.
Asian market experience.
Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.


There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

The range for Ontario area is $80,000-120,000 CAD.

Title: HR Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for an HR Data Analyst to join our small, high-impact HR Systems and Reporting team. Reporting to the Senior Manager, HR Reporting and Analytics, you will play a key role in advancing our data and reporting capabilities — turning complex HR data into actionable insights that support decision-making across the organization.




You are analytically minded, a self-starter, and thrive in an environment where precision, collaboration, and continuous improvement matter.




This position will be based at our Head Office in Markham, Ontario. Extendicare offers a hybrid working environment.




Key responsibilities include:

Partner with developers, functional leads, and stakeholders to design data schemas, define data feed requirements, and contribute to enterprise data architecture
Build and maintain dynamic Workday reports to support Operations and HR teams
Support HR initiatives through financial modelling, KPI development, and performance tracking
Assist the Payroll team with Federal and Provincial reporting programs for health care workers
Act as a liaison between HR functional user groups and technical teams — gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and translating them into effective solutions
Leverage AI tools to automate reporting workflows, accelerate data analysis, and surface insights at scale
Ensure requirements are clearly defined, documented, communicated, and validated across all assigned projects
Complete other duties as assigned




What we’re looking for:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
1–3 years of experience in data analysis or reporting, preferably in a fast-paced or growth-oriented environment
Proficiency in SQL Server (complex query writing) and Microsoft Excel
Demonstrated experience or strong interest in working with AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI for data analysis, prompt-based reporting)
Experience with Workday and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is a strong asset







What Extendicare has to offer:




At Extendicare, we believe that working as a team creates an environment that allows us to reach our potential. We value each employee, encourage equal opportunity for growth and recognize achievement. As a valued member of our team, you can expect:

Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

The Data Management Analyst is responsible for ensuring the completeness, reliability, and controls of investment-related data and records. This information is relied upon by the Investments, Accounting, Risk, and Legal teams to support reporting, compliance, and decision-making. The role involves maintaining data quality, implementing control processes, coordinating updates across systems, and ensuring that information is consistent, timely, and aligned with internal policies and regulatory requirements. The analyst collaborates with cross-functional teams to resolve discrepancies, strengthen reporting capabilities, and enhance data management workflows.

Responsibilities


Oversee the execution and maintenance of business and control processes that ensure security master records are properly established, maintained, and delivered to relevant stakeholders in a complete, reliable, and timely manner.
Supports the identification and resolution of business process gaps that hinder the Operation’s team from delivering reliable daily security master reference data.
Collaborates with other teams to assess and prioritize data needs and deficiencies and communicates with senior management to ensure requirements are addressed and gaps are resolved in a timely and effective manner.
Contributes to cross-functional and organization-wide initiatives, such as Aladdin MVP, focused on enhancing the overall quality of security data.
Partners with internal teams and external auditors to enhance the design and effectiveness of existing control frameworks, and to recommend and implement additional controls where necessary.
Executes additional tasks and responsibilities as required.


Qualifications And Requirements


Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) with at least two years of relevant experience.
Experience with order management systems (e.g., Aladdin), data vendors (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv), reconciliation tools (e.g., DUCO), and accounting systems (e.g., Clearwater).
Knowledge of private assets, fixed income, and structured products is preferred.
Experienced in handling and organizing large volumes of data.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including Macros, to analyze and manipulate data efficiently.
Understands regulatory-driven asset classification and its impact on rating and reporting processes
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including verbal, written, and presentation abilities, with a proven ability to work effectively with colleagues, clients, and external partners.
Detail-oriented and analytical, skilled at reviewing data, solving practical problems, and drawing accurate conclusions.
Highly organized and adaptable, able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office, SQL, and the preparation of reports, business correspondence, and procedural documentation.

At Fidelity Canada, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. The Advanced Analytics team within Fidelity Canada ULC’s finance department supports various business units and the senior executive team at fulfilling advanced analytical and reporting requirements. The Analyst, Advanced Analytics role plans, designs, develops, and deploys reporting and analytics throughout the organization, while objectively evaluating the effectiveness of various sales and marketing activities using appropriate data mining techniques.

How You’ll Make An Impact


Marketing, events, sales campaign analysis (AB tests, Pre vs. Post)
Support sales and marketing targeted campaigns
Participate in customer level analytical/research projects
Research and prototype advanced statistical/AI models
Complete ad-hoc requests for analysis, data extraction and information gathering
R&D new analytical tools and techniques
Augment periodic management reporting

What We’re Looking For


Completion of University degree (Engineering, Math/Statistics or Computer Science related) or equivalent work experience
Over 2-3 years of relevant work experience
Experience employing various statistical modelling and data analysis techniques, such as linear / logistic regression, decision trees, affinity analysis, clustering/segmentation and time series forecasting

MS Sales business operations team, oversees Microsoft's revenue reporting process, collaborating with source data partners, business users to address data or functional issues. The team conducts thorough data analysis to guarantee the precision and efficiency of reporting procedures.

Job Description


Write, test and schedule audits for data validations reports using SQL Stored Procedures, Views and Functions
Collecting and analyzing large and complex data sets
Validating data to ensure accuracy and completeness
Conducting ad-hoc analysis, solving data discrepancies, and generating actionable business insights.
Ability to work on Level 2 Service Requests from business users
Willing to extend support on production issues during non-business hours
Understand data lineage, data quality and relationships
Monitor data extract, transform and load jobs and respond to any job failures
Development support for platforms and applications assigned
Document knowledge base articles for Tier-1 and Tier-2
Dedicate 20%-30% of time for Development efforts – Automation of operational activities, data quality checks, application feature development, develop tabular models, bug fixes and reporting
Perform data engineering related activities e.g. developing and enhancing tools/solutions/processes based on data analysis and/or new customer requirements
Work with client and team members for performance improvement and suggestions
Awareness on azure skills

Required skill set:


Intermediate to expert level experience in Microsoft SQL Server - Writing Complex Queries; Debug existing Stored procedure; DB Performance improvement; Developing quality audits

Working knowledge on Azure stack – Synapse, Spark/Python, SQL Azure, Azure Data Factory (ADF) - Ability to quickly ramp up on Azure
Experience working on project management tools like Azure DevOps (ADO), JIRA, etc.
Good analytical and problem solving skills
Excellent communication skills and ability to work with customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams by effectively understanding the business requirements


Preferred Skills


Ability to work in agile environment, deal with ambiguity and critical thinking to achieve the expected results within SLAs
Having a systematic and logical approach to problem-solving
Prior experience in Microsoft landscape or Corporate finance space is preferred
Willing to learn new technologies
